title: DHS: ICE officers in Minneapolis shoot Venezuelan man in the leg
summary: The Department of Homeland Security says the shooting happened after the agent came under attack. Protestors have taken to the streets in Minneapolis, clashing with federal agents, after Renee Macklin Good's killing last week.
contentText:
